subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: Should ClickClack expose the new per-account maxTokens option, and what default should existing accounts receive when it is unset?
rationale: The configuration surface changes cost, latency, and delivery behavior, and the proposed 512 default performs worse than the current 96-token behavior in the PR’s own live test.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Keep 96 as the unset-account default, retain the opt-in maxTokens setting, and document that operators should tune it for their selected model.

options.title: Split the media fix
options.body: Land media delivery and retry reconciliation separately while deferring the model-budget configuration until its product contract is approved.

options.title: Approve a higher default
options.body: Choose a higher default only after representative live model evidence shows that the exact value improves delivery without unacceptable cost or latency.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Keep 96 as the unset-account default, retain the opt-in maxTokens setting, and document that operators should tune it for their selected model.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects steipete to introduction of the ClickClack runtime, and this choice concerns the user-facing default and public channel configuration contract.
